id-20260830-news-3.title: MBG Kitchen Partners Hold Peaceful Protest, Urge BGN to Accelerate Activation of Thousands of New SPPGs

segments.src: Sejumlah mitra penyedia Satuan Pelayanan Pemenuhan Gizi (SPPG) dikabarkan menggelar aksi unjuk rasa untuk menuntut kejelasan jadwal aktivasi dapur-dapur baru dalam program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG).
segments.tr: A number of partner providers for the Nutrition Fulfillment Service Unit (SPPG) reportedly held a protest to demand clarity on the activation schedule for new kitchens in the Free Nutritious Meal (MBG) program.

segments.src: Aksi ini muncul di tengah sorotan publik terhadap pengelolaan anggaran program serta evaluasi menyeluruh terhadap dapur-dapur yang selama ini beroperasi.
segments.tr: This action comes amid public scrutiny regarding the program's budget management and a comprehensive evaluation of the kitchens that have been operating so far.

segments.src: ## Tuntutan Mitra SPPG
segments.tr: ## SPPG Partner Demands

segments.src: Menurut keterangan dari perwakilan mitra yang menyampaikan aspirasinya, ribuan dapur baru yang sudah disiapkan dan memenuhi syarat administratif dilaporkan masih menunggu proses aktivasi resmi dari Badan Gizi Nasional (BGN).
segments.tr: According to statements from partner representatives voicing their aspirations, thousands of new kitchens that have been prepared and meet administrative requirements are reportedly still awaiting an official activation process from the National Nutrition Agency (BGN).

segments.src: Para mitra menyebut ketidakpastian jadwal ini berdampak langsung pada operasional bisnis mereka, termasuk beban biaya yang sudah dikeluarkan untuk mempersiapkan dapur sesuai standar yang ditetapkan.
segments.tr: The partners stated that this schedule uncertainty has a direct impact on their business operations, including the cost burdens already incurred to prepare the kitchens according to established standards.

segments.src: Para peserta aksi meminta BGN memberikan kepastian waktu serta transparansi mengenai kriteria dan tahapan aktivasi, agar mitra yang telah memenuhi persyaratan tidak menunggu tanpa kejelasan.
segments.tr: The protesters asked the BGN to provide certainty of time as well as transparency regarding the criteria and stages of activation, so that partners who have met the requirements do not have to wait indefinitely.

segments.src: ## Konteks: Evaluasi Anggaran dan Penutupan Dapur Bermasalah
segments.tr: ## Context: Budget Evaluation and Closure of Problematic Kitchens

segments.src: Aksi ini terjadi tak lama setelah mencuatnya sorotan terhadap potensi pemborosan anggaran program MBG yang disebut-sebut mencapai kisaran Rp10,5 triliun.
segments.tr: This action occurred shortly after the emergence of concerns regarding potential budget waste in the MBG program, which is rumored to reach around IDR 10.5 trillion.

segments.src: Angka tersebut menjadi bagian dari evaluasi yang tengah berjalan terhadap efisiensi dan tata kelola distribusi anggaran program gizi nasional ini.
segments.tr: This figure is part of an ongoing evaluation of the efficiency and governance of the national nutrition program's budget distribution.

segments.src: Selain itu, BGN sebelumnya juga mengumumkan langkah penutupan permanen terhadap 833 dapur SPPG yang dinilai bermasalah, baik dari sisi standar operasional, kepatuhan administratif, maupun aspek keamanan pangan.
segments.tr: In addition, the BGN previously announced a permanent closure step for 833 SPPG kitchens considered problematic, whether in terms of operational standards, administrative compliance, or food safety aspects.

segments.src: Langkah ini disebut sebagai bagian dari upaya perbaikan kualitas dan akuntabilitas program secara berkelanjutan.
segments.tr: This step is referred to as part of an effort to continuously improve the quality and accountability of the program.

segments.src: ## Respons BGN
segments.tr: ## BGN Response

segments.src: Menanggapi tuntutan para mitra, pihak BGN menyatakan bahwa proses aktivasi dapur baru tetap berjalan sesuai prosedur dan tahapan verifikasi yang berlaku.
segments.tr: Responding to the partners' demands, the BGN stated that the activation process for new kitchens continues to run according to applicable procedures and verification stages.

segments.src: BGN mengklaim saat ini masih terdapat ribuan calon SPPG baru dalam antrean aktivasi, dan proses tersebut memerlukan waktu untuk memastikan setiap dapur memenuhi standar gizi, keamanan pangan, serta kelayakan operasional sebelum resmi beroperasi.
segments.tr: The BGN claimed that there are still thousands of new prospective SPPGs in the activation queue, and the process takes time to ensure every kitchen meets nutrition standards, food safety, and operational feasibility before officially operating.

segments.src: BGN juga menegaskan bahwa proses evaluasi terhadap dapur-dapur yang sudah berjalan turut menjadi pertimbangan dalam menentukan kecepatan aktivasi dapur-dapur baru, guna menghindari pengulangan masalah serupa dengan yang menyebabkan penutupan ratusan dapur sebelumnya.
segments.tr: The BGN also emphasized that the evaluation process for kitchens currently running is also a consideration in determining the activation speed of new kitchens, to avoid repeating problems similar to those that caused the closure of hundreds of previous kitchens.

segments.src: ## Dinamika di Lapangan
segments.tr: ## Dynamics on the Ground

segments.src: Situasi ini mencerminkan tantangan dalam implementasi program MBG yang menyasar skala nasional dengan jumlah dapur yang terus bertambah.
segments.tr: This situation reflects the challenges in implementing the MBG program, which targets a national scale with an ever-increasing number of kitchens.

segments.src: Di satu sisi, pemerintah perlu memastikan tata kelola anggaran dan standar operasional tetap terjaga demi keberlanjutan program jangka panjang.
segments.tr: On the one hand, the government needs to ensure that budget governance and operational standards are maintained for the sake of the program's long-term sustainability.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, para mitra usaha kecil dan menengah yang telah berinvestasi menyiapkan dapur berharap adanya kepastian agar roda usaha mereka dapat berjalan.
segments.tr: On the other hand, small and medium business partners who have invested in preparing kitchens hope for certainty so that their business wheels can keep turning.

segments.src: Hingga saat ini, belum ada pengumuman resmi mengenai tenggat waktu pasti aktivasi 13.000 dapur baru yang dimaksud.
segments.tr: To date, there has been no official announcement regarding the exact deadline for the activation of the 13,000 new kitchens in question.

segments.src: Pihak BGN disebut akan terus melakukan koordinasi dengan para mitra SPPG untuk mencari titik temu antara kebutuhan percepatan program dan prinsip kehati-hatian dalam pengelolaan anggaran publik.
segments.tr: The BGN is said to continue coordinating with SPPG partners to find common ground between the need to accelerate the program and the principle of prudence in managing public budgets.

segments.src: Perkembangan lebih lanjut terkait jadwal aktivasi maupun hasil evaluasi anggaran program MBG akan terus dipantau, mengingat besarnya dampak program ini terhadap pemenuhan gizi anak-anak sekolah di berbagai daerah.
segments.tr: Further developments regarding the activation schedule and the results of the MBG program budget evaluation will continue to be monitored, given the magnitude of this program's impact on fulfilling the nutrition of school children in various regions.

id-20260830-news-1.title: Destry Damayanti Officially Becomes First Female Definitive Governor of BI, to be Inaugurated at DPR Plenary Session on September 1

segments.src: Komisi XI DPR RI resmi menyetujui Destry Damayanti sebagai Gubernur Bank Indonesia periode 2026-2031, menjadikannya perempuan pertama yang memimpin bank sentral Indonesia sejak lembaga ini berdiri.
segments.tr: Commission XI of the DPR RI has officially approved Destry Damayanti as the Governor of Bank Indonesia for the 2026-2031 period, making her the first woman to lead Indonesia's central bank since the institution was established.

segments.src: Persetujuan tersebut diambil melalui rapat kerja Komisi XI dan selanjutnya akan dibawa ke rapat paripurna DPR pada 1 September untuk proses pelantikan resmi.
segments.tr: The approval was reached through a working meeting of Commission XI and will subsequently be brought to the DPR plenary session on September 1 for the official inauguration process.

segments.src: ## Menggantikan Perry Warjiyo yang Mundur Mendadak
segments.tr: ## Replacing Perry Warjiyo Who Resigned Suddenly

segments.src: Proses pemilihan Gubernur BI kali ini berlangsung lebih cepat dari jadwal normal setelah Perry Warjiyo menyatakan mundur dari jabatannya sebelum masa tugasnya berakhir.
segments.tr: The selection process for the BI Governor this time took place faster than the normal schedule after Perry Warjiyo announced his resignation from his position before his term ended.

segments.src: Pengunduran diri yang disampaikan secara mendadak itu membuat DPR dan pemerintah harus segera memproses calon pengganti agar kekosongan kepemimpinan di bank sentral tidak berlangsung lama, mengingat peran strategis BI dalam menjaga stabilitas nilai tukar rupiah, inflasi, dan sistem keuangan nasional.
segments.tr: The sudden resignation meant that the DPR and the government had to immediately process a successor candidate so that the leadership vacuum at the central bank would not last long, given BI's strategic role in maintaining the stability of the rupiah exchange rate, inflation, and the national financial system.

segments.src: Sebagai Deputi Gubernur Senior BI, Destry Damayanti dinilai memiliki pemahaman mendalam atas kebijakan moneter yang sedang berjalan sehingga proses transisi kepemimpinan diharapkan berlangsung mulus tanpa mengganggu arah kebijakan yang sudah ditetapkan sebelumnya.
segments.tr: As the Senior Deputy Governor of BI, Destry Damayanti is considered to have a deep understanding of the ongoing monetary policy, so the leadership transition process is expected to run smoothly without disrupting the policy direction that has been previously established.

segments.src: ## Sosok Destry Damayanti
segments.tr: ## The Figure of Destry Damayanti

segments.src: Destry dikenal luas di kalangan pelaku pasar dan akademisi ekonomi berkat rekam jejaknya yang panjang, baik di sektor perbankan swasta maupun di bank sentral.
segments.tr: Destry is widely known among market players and economic academics for her long track record, both in the private banking sector and at the central bank.

segments.src: Sebelum menjabat di BI, ia pernah malang melintang sebagai ekonom di sejumlah lembaga keuangan terkemuka, sehingga dianggap memahami dinamika pasar dari sisi praktisi maupun regulator.
segments.tr: Before serving at BI, she had extensive experience as an economist at a number of leading financial institutions, so she is considered to understand market dynamics from the perspective of both a practitioner and a regulator.

segments.src: Dengan latar belakang tersebut, penunjukannya sebagai Gubernur BI dipandang sebagai bentuk pengakuan atas kompetensi dan konsistensi kinerjanya selama menjabat sebagai Deputi Gubernur Senior, bukan semata soal representasi gender.
segments.tr: With that background, her appointment as BI Governor is seen as a form of recognition of her competence and consistency in performance while serving as Senior Deputy Governor, not merely a matter of gender representation.

segments.src: ## Perempuan Pertama Pemimpin Bank Sentral RI
segments.tr: ## First Woman to Lead the Central Bank of RI

segments.src: Terpilihnya Destry menandai tonggak sejarah baru bagi Bank Indonesia.
segments.tr: Destry's election marks a new historical milestone for Bank Indonesia.

segments.src: Sepanjang sejarah lembaga ini, posisi Gubernur BI selalu diisi oleh laki-laki.
segments.tr: Throughout the history of this institution, the position of BI Governor has always been filled by men.

segments.src: Kalangan pemerhati kesetaraan gender di sektor keuangan menyambut positif perkembangan ini sebagai sinyal semakin terbukanya ruang bagi perempuan untuk menduduki posisi puncak di institusi strategis negara.
segments.tr: Observers of gender equality in the financial sector have welcomed this development as a signal of the increasingly open space for women to occupy top positions in the country's strategic institutions.

segments.src: Sejumlah anggota Komisi XI DPR dalam rapat kerja menyampaikan apresiasi atas rekam jejak dan kapasitas Destry, sekaligus berharap kepemimpinannya dapat menjaga kesinambungan kebijakan moneter di tengah tantangan ekonomi global yang masih fluktuatif.
segments.tr: A number of Commission XI DPR members in the working meeting expressed their appreciation for Destry's track record and capacity, while also hoping that her leadership could maintain the continuity of monetary policy amidst the still fluctuating global economic challenges.

segments.src: ## Agenda Pelantikan dan Tantangan ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Inauguration Agenda and Future Challenges

segments.src: Setelah disetujui di tingkat Komisi XI, nama Destry Damayanti akan dibawa ke rapat paripurna DPR pada 1 September untuk disahkan secara resmi sebagai Gubernur BI definitif.
segments.tr: After being approved at the Commission XI level, Destry Damayanti's name will be brought to the DPR plenary session on September 1 to be officially confirmed as the definitive BI Governor.

segments.src: Proses pelantikan ini menjadi penanda dimulainya masa jabatannya untuk periode lima tahun ke depan, yakni 2026-2031.
segments.tr: This inauguration process marks the beginning of her term for the next five years, namely 2026-2031.

segments.src: Begitu resmi dilantik, sejumlah pekerjaan rumah akan langsung menanti, mulai dari menjaga stabilitas rupiah di tengah ketidakpastian ekonomi global, mengendalikan inflasi agar tetap berada dalam target yang ditetapkan pemerintah, hingga memastikan koordinasi kebijakan moneter dan fiskal tetap solid bersama Kementerian Keuangan dan otoritas terkait lainnya.
segments.tr: Once officially inaugurated, a number of tasks will immediately await, starting from maintaining rupiah stability amidst global economic uncertainty, controlling inflation to remain within the targets set by the government, to ensuring that monetary and fiscal policy coordination remains solid with the Ministry of Finance and other relevant authorities.

segments.src: Pelaku pasar dan pengamat ekonomi turut memantau bagaimana arah kebijakan BI ke depan di bawah kepemimpinan baru ini, khususnya terkait konsistensi kebijakan suku bunga dan langkah-langkah menjaga kepercayaan investor terhadap perekonomian Indonesia.
segments.tr: Market players and economic observers are also monitoring how the direction of BI's policy will go forward under this new leadership, particularly regarding the consistency of interest rate policies and steps to maintain investor confidence in the Indonesian economy.

segments.src: Dengan pelantikan yang akan berlangsung pada 1 September, publik menantikan pernyataan resmi pertama Destry Damayanti sebagai Gubernur BI mengenai arah kebijakan moneter yang akan ditempuh untuk lima tahun ke depan.
segments.tr: With the inauguration taking place on September 1, the public is awaiting Destry Damayanti's first official statement as BI Governor regarding the monetary policy direction that will be pursued for the next five years.

id-20260830-news-2.title: Indonesia's Government Debt Reaches Rp10,293 Trillion as of June 2026, Up Rp373 Trillion in Three Months

segments.src: ## Posisi Utang Terbaru
segments.tr: ## Latest Debt Position

segments.src: Posisi utang pemerintah pusat Indonesia per akhir Juni 2026 tercatat mencapai Rp10.293 triliun, berdasarkan data yang dipublikasikan otoritas fiskal.
segments.tr: The central government debt position of Indonesia as of the end of June 2026 was recorded at Rp10,293 trillion, based on data published by fiscal authorities.

segments.src: Angka ini menunjukkan kenaikan sekitar Rp373 triliun dibandingkan posisi tiga bulan sebelumnya, sebuah lonjakan yang cukup signifikan dalam kurun waktu singkat dan kembali memantik perhatian publik terhadap arah pengelolaan fiskal nasional.
segments.tr: This figure indicates an increase of about Rp373 trillion compared to the position three months prior, a fairly significant surge in a short period and once again drawing public attention to the direction of national fiscal management.

segments.src: Kenaikan tersebut dilaporkan didorong oleh kombinasi penerbitan Surat Berharga Negara (SBN) untuk membiayai defisit anggaran, pelemahan nilai tukar rupiah yang memengaruhi nilai utang berdenominasi valuta asing, serta kebutuhan pembiayaan program-program prioritas pemerintah yang berjalan sepanjang tahun anggaran.
segments.tr: This increase is reported to be driven by a combination of the issuance of State Securities (SBN) to finance the budget deficit, the depreciation of the rupiah exchange rate which affects the value of foreign currency-denominated debt, and the financing needs for ongoing government priority programs throughout the fiscal year.

segments.src: ## Rasio Utang terhadap PDB
segments.tr: ## Debt-to-GDP Ratio

segments.src: Yang menjadi sorotan utama bukan hanya nilai nominal utang, melainkan rasio utang terhadap Produk Domestik Bruto (PDB) yang kini berada di level 41,26 persen.
segments.tr: The main spotlight is not only on the nominal value of the debt, but also on the debt-to-Gross Domestic Product (GDP) ratio which now stands at 41.26 percent.

segments.src: Rasio ini naik dibandingkan periode sebelumnya, namun secara resmi masih berada jauh di bawah batas maksimal 60 persen yang diamanatkan Undang-Undang Nomor 17 Tahun 2003 tentang Keuangan Negara.
segments.tr: This ratio is up compared to the previous period, but officially remains well below the maximum limit of 60 percent mandated by Law Number 17 of 2003 concerning State Finances.

segments.src: Kementerian Keuangan menegaskan bahwa selama rasio ini masih terkendali di bawah ambang batas undang-undang, kapasitas fiskal negara untuk membayar kewajiban utang dinilai tetap terjaga.
segments.tr: The Ministry of Finance emphasized that as long as this ratio remains controlled below the statutory threshold, the state's fiscal capacity to pay its debt obligations is considered to remain maintained.

segments.src: Pemerintah juga menyebut bahwa mayoritas utang masih didominasi oleh instrumen rupiah dan bertenor menengah-panjang, sehingga risiko gejolak jangka pendek relatif dapat dimitigasi.
segments.tr: The government also noted that the majority of debt is still dominated by rupiah instruments and medium-long tenors, so short-term fluctuation risks can be relatively mitigated.

segments.src: ## Perdebatan di Kalangan Ekonom
segments.tr: ## Debate Among Economists

segments.src: Meski begitu, kenaikan utang dalam waktu singkat ini memicu perdebatan di kalangan ekonom dan pengamat kebijakan publik.
segments.tr: Even so, this rapid increase in debt has sparked debate among economists and public policy observers.

segments.src: Sebagian ekonom menilai tren peningkatan utang yang konsisten setiap tahun perlu diwaspadai, terutama jika tidak diimbangi dengan pertumbuhan penerimaan negara yang memadai.
segments.tr: Some economists consider that the consistent upward trend in debt every year needs to be watched out for, especially if not balanced with adequate state revenue growth.

segments.src: Mereka mengingatkan bahwa rasio yang masih di bawah 60 persen bukan berarti bebas risiko sepenuhnya, karena beban pembayaran bunga utang (debt service) yang terus membesar dapat menggerus ruang fiskal untuk belanja produktif seperti infrastruktur, pendidikan, dan kesehatan.
segments.tr: They remind that a ratio still below 60 percent does not mean it is completely risk-free, because the continuously growing burden of debt service payments can erode fiscal space for productive spending such as infrastructure, education, and health.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, sejumlah ekonom lain berpandangan lebih optimistis.
segments.tr: On the other hand, a number of other economists hold a more optimistic view.

segments.src: Mereka menilai rasio utang Indonesia masih tergolong moderat jika dibandingkan dengan banyak negara berkembang maupun negara maju lainnya yang rasio utangnya jauh melampaui 60 persen bahkan hingga di atas 100 persen dari PDB.
segments.tr: They assess that Indonesia's debt ratio is still considered moderate compared to many developing and other developed countries whose debt ratios far exceed 60 percent, even up to above 100 percent of GDP.

segments.src: Selama pertumbuhan ekonomi domestik tetap positif dan defisit anggaran terjaga dalam batas wajar, penambahan utang dianggap sebagai instrumen pembiayaan yang lumrah, bukan indikator krisis.
segments.tr: As long as domestic economic growth remains positive and the budget deficit is maintained within reasonable limits, debt addition is considered a common financing instrument, not a crisis indicator.

segments.src: ## Faktor yang Perlu Dicermati
segments.tr: ## Factors to Watch

segments.src: Beberapa faktor yang menjadi perhatian bersama ke depan antara lain:
segments.tr: Several factors of common concern moving forward include:

segments.src: - **Stabilitas nilai tukar rupiah**, karena fluktuasi kurs dapat memengaruhi nilai utang berdenominasi asing secara signifikan.
segments.tr: - **Rupiah exchange rate stability**, because currency fluctuations can significantly affect the value of foreign-denominated debt.

segments.src: - **Tren suku bunga global**, yang berdampak langsung pada biaya penerbitan surat utang baru maupun refinancing utang jatuh tempo.
segments.tr: - **Global interest rate trends**, which have a direct impact on the cost of issuing new debt securities as well as refinancing maturing debt.

segments.src: - **Kinerja penerimaan pajak dan pendapatan negara**, sebagai penopang utama kemampuan membayar kewajiban utang tanpa terus-menerus menambah pinjaman baru.
segments.tr: - **Tax revenue and state income performance**, as the main pillar of the ability to pay debt obligations without continually adding new loans.

segments.src: - **Efektivitas belanja negara**, agar dana hasil utang benar-benar mendorong produktivitas ekonomi jangka panjang, bukan sekadar menutup kebutuhan operasional rutin.
segments.tr: - **Effectiveness of state spending**, so that debt funds truly drive long-term economic productivity, rather than merely covering routine operational needs.

segments.src: ## Respons Pemerintah
segments.tr: ## Government Response

segments.src: Pemerintah menyatakan akan terus menjaga kehati-hatian fiskal (prudent fiscal management) dengan memantau secara berkala rasio utang, komposisi jenis utang, serta jadwal jatuh tempo agar tidak menimbulkan tekanan pembayaran yang menumpuk pada periode tertentu.
segments.tr: The government stated it will continue to maintain prudent fiscal management by periodically monitoring the debt ratio, debt type composition, and maturity schedules so as not to cause payment pressures piling up in certain periods.

segments.src: Strategi pembiayaan juga disebut akan terus dioptimalkan melalui diversifikasi instrumen, termasuk memperbesar porsi pembiayaan domestik guna mengurangi ketergantungan pada utang luar negeri.
segments.tr: Financing strategies are also said to continue to be optimized through instrument diversification, including enlarging the portion of domestic financing to reduce dependence on foreign debt.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Lonjakan utang pemerintah menjadi Rp10.293 triliun dengan rasio 41,26 persen terhadap PDB memang masih berada dalam koridor yang diizinkan undang-undang.
segments.tr: The surge in government debt to Rp10,293 trillion with a ratio of 41.26 percent to GDP is indeed still within the corridor permitted by law.

segments.src: Namun, laju kenaikan yang cukup cepat dalam tiga bulan terakhir menjadi pengingat pentingnya pengelolaan fiskal yang disiplin dan transparan.
segments.tr: However, the fairly rapid pace of increase in the last three months serves as a reminder of the importance of disciplined and transparent fiscal management.

segments.src: Perdebatan antara pandangan yang lebih waspada dan yang lebih optimistis mencerminkan kompleksitas dalam menilai keberlanjutan utang suatu negara—bukan sekadar soal angka rasio, tetapi juga soal bagaimana dana tersebut dikelola dan dimanfaatkan untuk mendorong pertumbuhan ekonomi yang berkelanjutan bagi masyarakat luas.
segments.tr: The debate between the more cautious and the more optimistic views reflects the complexity in assessing a country's debt sustainability—not just about the ratio numbers, but also about how those funds are managed and utilized to drive sustainable economic growth for the broader community.

id-20260830-intro-agriculture-11.title: [Agronomy #11] Why Do Plants Get "Sick"? Understanding Plant Diseases and How to Control Them

segments.src: > Sama seperti manusia, tanaman juga bisa terserang penyakit oleh mikroorganisme. Kalau kita paham siapa penyebabnya dan bagaimana ia menyebar, kita bisa menyusun strategi pengendalian yang tepat sebelum panen gagal.
segments.tr: > Just like humans, plants can also be attacked by diseases caused by microorganisms. If we understand who the culprit is and how it spreads, we can develop appropriate control strategies before the harvest fails.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Concept of the Day

segments.src: Penyakit tanaman (dalam bahasa Inggris *plant disease*) muncul ketika sebuah tanaman terganggu fungsinya secara terus-menerus oleh penyebab tertentu, sehingga daun menguning, batang membusuk, atau buah gagal terbentuk.
segments.tr: Plant disease occurs when a plant's function is continuously disrupted by a specific cause, resulting in yellowing leaves, rotting stems, or failure to form fruit.

segments.src: Para ahli menggambarkan syarat munculnya penyakit dengan istilah **segitiga penyakit** (*disease triangle*): penyakit hanya terjadi bila tiga hal bertemu sekaligus, yaitu ada **patogen** (penyebab yang ganas), ada **inang** yang rentan (tanaman itu sendiri), dan ada **lingkungan** yang mendukung (misalnya lembap dan hangat).
segments.tr: Experts describe the conditions for the emergence of disease using the term **disease triangle**: disease only occurs when three things meet simultaneously, namely the presence of a **pathogen** (a virulent cause), a susceptible **host** (the plant itself), and a favorable **environment** (e.g., humid and warm).

segments.src: Jika salah satu sisi hilang, penyakit tidak jadi berkembang.
segments.tr: If one side is missing, the disease will not develop.

segments.src: Prinsip inilah yang menjadi dasar semua cara pengendalian.
segments.tr: This principle is the foundation for all control methods.

segments.src: Penyebab penyakit dibagi dua kelompok besar.
segments.tr: Disease causes are divided into two major groups.

segments.src: Pertama, **penyebab biotik** yaitu makhluk hidup: jamur (*cendawan*) yang paling banyak menyerang, bakteri, virus, dan nematoda (cacing halus di tanah).
segments.tr: First, **biotic causes**, which are living organisms: fungi (the most common attackers), bacteria, viruses, and nematodes (microscopic worms in the soil).

segments.src: Kedua, **penyebab abiotik** yaitu faktor tak hidup seperti kekurangan hara, tanah terlalu asam, atau keracunan pupuk.
segments.tr: Second, **abiotic causes**, which are non-living factors such as nutrient deficiency, overly acidic soil, or fertilizer toxicity.

segments.src: Bedanya penting: penyakit biotik bisa menular dari satu tanaman ke tanaman lain, sedangkan yang abiotik tidak.
segments.tr: The difference is important: biotic diseases can spread from one plant to another, while abiotic ones cannot.

segments.src: Agar patogen bisa menyebar, ia butuh "jalan" atau **jalur penularan**: terbawa angin (spora jamur), terbawa air hujan atau air irigasi, dibawa serangga vektor (misalnya wereng membawa virus), menempel pada benih dan bibit, atau bertahan di sisa tanaman dan tanah dari musim sebelumnya.
segments.tr: For a pathogen to spread, it needs a "path" or **transmission route**: carried by wind (fungal spores), carried by rainwater or irrigation water, carried by insect vectors (e.g., planthoppers carrying viruses), attached to seeds and seedlings, or surviving in plant debris and soil from the previous season.

segments.src: Memutus jalur inilah kunci pencegahan.
segments.tr: Breaking this route is the key to prevention.

segments.src: Strategi pengendalian modern tidak mengandalkan satu cara saja, melainkan menggabungkan beberapa metode.
segments.tr: Modern control strategies do not rely on just one method, but rather combine several approaches.

segments.src: Pendekatan ini disebut **Pengendalian Hama Terpadu (PHT)**: mulai dari cara **kultur teknis** (rotasi tanaman, jarak tanam, sanitasi lahan), memilih **varietas tahan**, pengendalian **hayati** (memakai musuh alami atau mikroba baik), sampai pilihan terakhir yaitu **kimiawi** (fungisida/bakterisida) yang dipakai seperlunya.
segments.tr: This approach is called **Integrated Pest Management (IPM)**: starting from **cultural practices** (crop rotation, planting distance, field sanitation), choosing **resistant varieties**, **biological** control (using natural enemies or beneficial microbes), to the last resort, which is **chemical** (fungicides/bactericides) used only as necessary.

segments.src: Tujuannya menekan penyakit sambil menjaga biaya, kesehatan, dan lingkungan.
segments.tr: The goal is to suppress disease while maintaining costs, health, and the environment.

segments.src: ## Dalam Keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Bayangkan Pak Slamet, petani padi di Karawang, Jawa Barat.
segments.tr: Imagine Mr. Slamet, a rice farmer in Karawang, West Java.

segments.src: Musim lalu ia panik karena bercak-bercak berbentuk mata pada daun padinya meluas cepat, ujung daun mengering seperti terbakar.
segments.tr: Last season, he panicked because eye-shaped spots on his rice leaves spread rapidly, and the leaf tips dried up as if burned.

segments.src: Itu ciri **blas** (*blast*), penyakit yang disebabkan jamur dan menyebar lewat angin serta percikan air, apalagi saat kabut pagi dan sawah terlalu rapat.
segments.tr: That is a characteristic of **blast**, a disease caused by fungi that spreads through wind and water splashes, especially during morning fog and when the rice field is too dense.

segments.src: Tahun ini Pak Slamet mengubah strategi mengikuti anjuran penyuluh.
segments.tr: This year, Mr. Slamet changed his strategy following the extension worker's advice.

segments.src: Ia menerapkan segitiga penyakit tanpa menyadari istilahnya: menanam **varietas tahan** (menyerang sisi "inang rentan"), mengatur jarak tanam agar angin lewat dan daun cepat kering (menyerang sisi "lingkungan"), dan tidak berlebihan memberi pupuk urea karena daun yang terlalu "hijau subur" justru mengundang jamur.
segments.tr: He applied the disease triangle without realizing the term: planting **resistant varieties** (attacking the "susceptible host" side), adjusting planting distance so wind can pass through and leaves dry quickly (attacking the "environment" side), and not over-applying urea fertilizer because leaves that are too "lush green" actually invite fungi.

segments.src: Fungisida hanya ia semprot saat gejala awal benar-benar muncul.
segments.tr: He only sprays fungicide when initial symptoms truly appear.

segments.src: Hitung-hitungannya nyata.
segments.tr: The calculations are real.

segments.src: Kalau serangan blas berat, hasil bisa turun sampai separuh.
segments.tr: If a blast attack is severe, yields can drop by up to half.

segments.src: Andai satu hektar biasanya menghasilkan sekitar 6 ton gabah senilai puluhan juta Rupiah, kehilangan setengahnya berarti belasan juta Rupiah melayang.
segments.tr: If one hectare usually produces about 6 tons of grain worth tens of millions of Rupiah, losing half means tens of millions of Rupiah gone.

segments.src: Sementara biaya pencegahan seperti benih tahan dan pengaturan tanam jauh lebih murah.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, prevention costs like resistant seeds and planting management are much cheaper.

segments.src: Di sinilah petani paham: mencegah penyakit lebih hemat daripada mengobati.
segments.tr: This is where farmers understand: preventing disease is more economical than treating it.

segments.src: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Penyakit tanaman muncul saat patogen, inang rentan, dan lingkungan mendukung bertemu sekaligus (segitiga penyakit).
segments.tr: 1. Plant disease occurs when a pathogen, a susceptible host, and a favorable environment meet simultaneously (disease triangle).

segments.src: 2. Penyebabnya bisa biotik (jamur, bakteri, virus, nematoda) yang menular, atau abiotik (kurang hara, keracunan) yang tidak menular; patogen menyebar lewat angin, air, serangga, benih, dan tanah.
segments.tr: 2. Causes can be biotic (fungi, bacteria, viruses, nematodes) which are contagious, or abiotic (nutrient deficiency, toxicity) which are not contagious; pathogens spread via wind, water, insects, seeds, and soil.

segments.src: 3. Pengendalian terbaik menggabungkan banyak cara (PHT): kultur teknis, varietas tahan, hayati, baru kimiawi seperlunya.
segments.tr: 3. The best control combines many methods (IPM): cultural practices, resistant varieties, biological, and only chemical as a last resort.

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Terms of the Day

segments.src: - **Patogen**: makhluk atau agen penyebab penyakit, seperti jamur, bakteri, atau virus.
segments.tr: - **Pathogen**: an organism or agent that causes disease, such as fungi, bacteria, or viruses.

segments.src: - **Segitiga penyakit**: konsep bahwa penyakit hanya muncul bila patogen, inang rentan, dan lingkungan pendukung hadir bersamaan.
segments.tr: - **Disease triangle**: the concept that disease only appears when a pathogen, susceptible host, and favorable environment are present simultaneously.

segments.src: - **Biotik dan abiotik**: penyebab hidup (menular) versus penyebab tak hidup seperti kekurangan hara (tidak menular).
segments.tr: - **Biotic and abiotic**: living causes (contagious) versus non-living causes like nutrient deficiency (not contagious).

segments.src: - **Vektor**: organisme, biasanya serangga, yang membawa dan memindahkan patogen antar tanaman.
segments.tr: - **Vector**: an organism, usually an insect, that carries and transfers pathogens between plants.

segments.src: - **PHT (Pengendalian Hama Terpadu)**: strategi menggabungkan beberapa metode pengendalian dan menempatkan pestisida kimia sebagai pilihan terakhir.
segments.tr: - **IPM (Integrated Pest Management)**: a strategy combining several control methods and placing chemical pesticides as the last resort.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1) B — penyakit butuh ketiga sisi bertemu; menghilangkan satu sisi cukup untuk mencegahnya.
segments.tr: *Answers: 1) B — disease needs all three sides to meet; eliminating one side is enough to prevent it.

segments.src: 2) Salah — penyebab abiotik seperti kekurangan hara tidak menular; hanya penyebab biotik yang bisa menyebar antar tanaman.
segments.tr: 2) False — abiotic causes like nutrient deficiency are not contagious; only biotic causes can spread between plants.

segments.src: 3) C — rotasi tanaman dan pengaturan jarak tanam adalah kultur teknis; menyemprot fungisida termasuk kimiawi dan melepas musuh alami termasuk hayati.*
segments.tr: 3) C — crop rotation and planting distance adjustment are cultural practices; spraying fungicide is chemical, and releasing natural enemies is biological.*
